race.comment: KEEN OBSERVER (11) has just found one better in all three starts to date, beaten in the market all three times but running well, no match for what looks a talented filly at Seymour last time out. Doubt he has to do any more to be breaking through here. EGYPTIAN THORN (5) resumes for his second campaign. He was narrowly beaten in his first two career starts before a sound effort as favourite at Swan Hill. Should be ready to run well here. PURGATORIO (13) wasn't far away fresh at Seymour over this trip and should come on from that. Rolls forward and is in the mix. GENOMIC (6) resumes. He showed ability in some handy races last time in and should go well fresh. APOCALYPSE (8) is a Wild Ruler gelding for the McEvoy yard who can run well. Watch the market.
